Clubs
clubs@earlsfield.wandsworth.sch.uk
We run a variety of clubs at Earlsfield and try to cater for as many children covering a variety of activities. Clubs are run by staff or external providers.
Our clubs are popular and we offer over 450 places in total from Reception to Year 6. Clubs run on a termly basis. If they are fee paying, all payments must be made up-front via parent pay or to the club provider.
Terms and Conditions
When signing your child/ren up to a club you are automatically agreeing to the terms and conditions of club provision at Earlsfield.
By signing your child up to a club you agree to the following terms and conditions.
We share clubs via Arbor termly
Parents book places on a first come first serve basis through Arbor or the provider website.
Access to the school site
Parents and carers are committed to collecting their child on time. Start and finish times are shared in the club information through parentmail and on the school website.
We reserve the right to withdraw a child’s place at after school clubs:
Fresh fruit, dried fruit and water only in line with national guidelines. No crisps, chocolate bars etc.
Sharing of information
Earlsfield Primary School shares data with Specialist Club external providers, this is to ensure they have correct registers and contact details should they need to contact parents in the form of a telephone number or email address. All providers adhere to our Acceptable Use Agreement and this information will not be shared
No refund will be available for illness.
